from manim import *

class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def make_spyder(self, center):
        c = np.array(center)
        head = Circle(
            radius=0.38,
            color=BLUE_E,
            fill_color=BLUE_E,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(c + UP * 0.38)
        body = Circle(
            radius=0.30,
            color=BLUE_D,
            fill_color=BLUE_D,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(c + DOWN * 0.25)
        eye_l = Circle(
            radius=0.055,
            color=WHITE,
            fill_color=WHITE,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(c + UP * 0.48 + LEFT * 0.13)
        eye_r = Circle(
            radius=0.055,
            color=WHITE,
            fill_color=WHITE,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(c + UP * 0.48 + RIGHT * 0.13)
        legs = VGroup(
            Line(
                c + LEFT * 0.18 + DOWN * 0.35,
                c + LEFT * 0.62 + DOWN * 0.62,
                color=BLUE_E,
                stroke_width=5,
            ),
            Line(
                c + LEFT * 0.22 + DOWN * 0.22,
                c + LEFT * 0.70 + DOWN * 0.20,
                color=BLUE_E,
                stroke_width=5,
            ),
            Line(
                c + LEFT * 0.16 + UP * 0.02,
                c + LEFT * 0.58 + UP * 0.32,
                color=BLUE_E,
                stroke_width=5,
            ),
            Line(
                c + RIGHT * 0.18 + DOWN * 0.35,
                c + RIGHT * 0.62 + DOWN * 0.62,
                color=BLUE_E,
                stroke_width=5,
            ),
            Line(
                c + RIGHT * 0.22 + DOWN * 0.22,
                c + RIGHT * 0.70 + DOWN * 0.20,
                color=BLUE_E,
                stroke_width=5,
            ),
            Line(
                c + RIGHT * 0.16 + UP * 0.02,
                c + RIGHT * 0.58 + UP * 0.32,
                color=BLUE_E,
                stroke_width=5,
            ),
        )
        smile = Arc(
            radius=0.16,
            start_angle=PI + 0.25,
            angle=PI - 0.5,
            arc_center=c + UP * 0.27,
            color=WHITE,
            stroke_width=3,
        )
        return VGroup(head, body, eye_l, eye_r, legs, smile)

    def make_proof(self, center):
        c = np.array(center)
        head = Circle(
            radius=0.48,
            color=RED_E,
            fill_color=RED_E,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(c + UP * 0.30)
        body = RoundedRectangle(
            corner_radius=0.12,
            width=0.85,
            height=0.72,
            color=RED_D,
            fill_color=RED_D,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(c + DOWN * 0.45)
        eye_l = Circle(
            radius=0.07,
            color=YELLOW,
            fill_color=YELLOW,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(c + UP * 0.40 + LEFT * 0.17)
        eye_r = Circle(
            radius=0.07,
            color=YELLOW,
            fill_color=YELLOW,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(c + UP * 0.40 + RIGHT * 0.17)
        brow_l = Line(
            c + LEFT * 0.30 + UP * 0.57,
            c + LEFT * 0.08 + UP * 0.49,
            color=BLACK,
            stroke_width=5,
        )
        brow_r = Line(
            c + RIGHT * 0.30 + UP * 0.57,
            c + RIGHT * 0.08 + UP * 0.49,
            color=BLACK,
            stroke_width=5,
        )
        mouth = Line(
            c + LEFT * 0.18 + UP * 0.13,
            c + RIGHT * 0.18 + UP * 0.13,
            color=BLACK,
            stroke_width=4,
        )
        arms = VGroup(
            Line(
                c + LEFT * 0.35 + DOWN * 0.35,
                c + LEFT * 0.82 + UP * 0.02,
                color=RED_E,
                stroke_width=7,
            ),
            Line(
                c + RIGHT * 0.35 + DOWN * 0.35,
                c + RIGHT * 0.82 + UP * 0.02,
                color=RED_E,
                stroke_width=7,
            ),
        )
        legs = VGroup(
            Line(
                c + LEFT * 0.18 + DOWN * 0.78,
                c + LEFT * 0.48 + DOWN * 1.10,
                color=RED_E,
                stroke_width=7,
            ),
            Line(
                c + RIGHT * 0.18 + DOWN * 0.78,
                c + RIGHT * 0.48 + DOWN * 1.10,
                color=RED_E,
                stroke_width=7,
            ),
        )
        return VGroup(
            head,
            body,
            eye_l,
            eye_r,
            brow_l,
            brow_r,
            mouth,
            arms,
            legs,
        )

    def construct(self):
        title = Text(
            "THE SWING-DODGE",
            font_size=40,
            color=WHITE,
        ).to_edge(UP, buff=0.42)

        caption = Text(
            "Spyder Math swings over ProofMotion!",
            font_size=27,
            color=YELLOW,
        ).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.25)

        pivot = np.array([0.0, 0.25, 0.0])
        path = Arc(
            radius=2.5,
            start_angle=2.35,
            angle=-1.55,
            arc_center=pivot,
            color=GREY_B,
            stroke_width=3,
        )

        start = path.get_start()
        spyder = self.make_spyder(start)
        proof = self.make_proof([0, -2.15, 0])

        spyder_label = Text(
            "Spyder Math",
            font_size=24,
            color=BLUE_B,
        ).next_to(spyder, RIGHT, buff=0.16)
        swinger = VGroup(spyder, spyder_label)

        proof_label = Text(
            "ProofMotion",
            font_size=24,
            color=RED_B,
        ).next_to(proof, RIGHT, buff=0.15)

        pivot_dot = Dot(pivot, radius=0.10, color=YELLOW)

        rope = always_redraw(
            lambda: Line(
                pivot,
                spyder.get_center() + DOWN * 0.05,
                color=YELLOW,
                stroke_width=4,
            )
        )

        motion = VGroup(
            Arc(
                radius=2.7,
                start_angle=2.28,
                angle=-0.38,
                arc_center=pivot,
                color=TEAL,
                stroke_width=6,
            ),
            Arc(
                radius=2.88,
                start_angle=2.12,
                angle=-0.34,
                arc_center=pivot,
                color=TEAL,
                stroke_width=4,
            ),
            Line(
                [-4.3, 1.05, 0],
                [-3.65, 1.42, 0],
                color=TEAL,
                stroke_width=5,
            ),
            Line(
                [3.4, 1.35, 0],
                [4.1, 1.65, 0],
                color=TEAL,
                stroke_width=5,
            ),
        )

        agitation = VGroup(
            Arc(
                radius=0.92,
                start_angle=0.25,
                angle=1.0,
                arc_center=np.array([0, -2.15, 0]),
                color=ORANGE,
                stroke_width=4,
            ),
            Line(
                [-1.35, -1.55, 0],
                [-1.05, -1.30, 0],
                color=ORANGE,
                stroke_width=4,
            ),
            Line(
                [1.05, -1.30, 0],
                [1.35, -1.55, 0],
                color=ORANGE,
                stroke_width=4,
            ),
        )

        self.play(
            FadeIn(title),
            FadeIn(caption),
            run_time=1.2,
        )
        self.play(
            Create(path),
            FadeIn(pivot_dot),
            Create(rope),
            FadeIn(swinger),
            FadeIn(proof),
            FadeIn(proof_label),
            Create(agitation),
            run_time=2.0,
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Create(motion), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(
            MoveAlongPath(
                swinger,
                path,
                rate_func=there_and_back,
            ),
            run_time=4.0,
        )
        self.wait(1.0)
        self.play(
            FadeOut(
                VGroup(
                    title,
                    caption,
                    path,
                    pivot_dot,
                    rope,
                    swinger,
                    proof,
                    proof_label,
                    motion,
                    agitation,
                )
            ),
            run_time=1.0,
        )
        self.wait(0.5)

from manim import *

class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        angle = ValueTracker(-0.45)
        orb_center = np.array([0.0, -0.15, 0.0])

        orb = Circle(
            radius=1.8,
            color=RED_E,
            fill_color=RED_E,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(orb_center)

        rim = Circle(
            radius=1.8,
            color=ORANGE,
            stroke_width=8,
        ).move_to(orb_center)

        left_eye = Polygon(
            [-0.95, 0.35, 0],
            [-0.28, 0.48, 0],
            [-0.38, 0.18, 0],
            [-0.9, 0.12, 0],
            color=WHITE,
            fill_color=WHITE,
            fill_opacity=1,
        )

        right_eye = Polygon(
            [0.28, 0.48, 0],
            [0.95, 0.35, 0],
            [0.9, 0.12, 0],
            [0.38, 0.18, 0],
            color=WHITE,
            fill_color=WHITE,
            fill_opacity=1,
        )

        pupil_l = Ellipse(
            width=0.14,
            height=0.24,
            color=BLACK,
            fill_color=BLACK,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to([-0.56, 0.28, 0])

        pupil_r = Ellipse(
            width=0.14,
            height=0.24,
            color=BLACK,
            fill_color=BLACK,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to([0.56, 0.28, 0])

        brow_l = Line(
            [-0.98, 0.72, 0],
            [-0.3, 0.53, 0],
            color=BLACK,
            stroke_width=12,
        )

        brow_r = Line(
            [0.98, 0.72, 0],
            [0.3, 0.53, 0],
            color=BLACK,
            stroke_width=12,
        )

        mouth = Arc(
            radius=0.55,
            start_angle=PI,
            angle=PI,
            color=BLACK,
            stroke_width=10,
        ).move_to([0, -0.62, 0])

        fang_l = Polygon(
            [-0.34, -0.62, 0],
            [-0.15, -0.62, 0],
            [-0.26, -0.96, 0],
            color=WHITE,
            fill_color=WHITE,
            fill_opacity=1,
        )

        fang_r = Polygon(
            [0.15, -0.62, 0],
            [0.34, -0.62, 0],
            [0.26, -0.96, 0],
            color=WHITE,
            fill_color=WHITE,
            fill_opacity=1,
        )

        orb_name = Text(
            "ProofMotion",
            font_size=28,
            color=WHITE,
        ).move_to([0, -2.28, 0])

        orb_group = VGroup(
            orb,
            rim,
            left_eye,
            right_eye,
            pupil_l,
            pupil_r,
            brow_l,
            brow_r,
            mouth,
            fang_l,
            fang_r,
            orb_name,
        )

        def spider():
            a = angle.get_value()
            pivot = np.array([0.0, 2.0, 0.0])
            bob = pivot + 2.05 * np.array(
                [np.sin(a), -np.cos(a), 0.0]
            )

            rope = Line(
                pivot,
                bob,
                color=GRAY_B,
                stroke_width=5,
            )

            body = Circle(
                radius=0.28,
                color=PURPLE,
                fill_color=PURPLE,
                fill_opacity=1,
            ).move_to(bob)

            head = Circle(
                radius=0.2,
                color=PURPLE_A,
                fill_color=PURPLE_A,
                fill_opacity=1,
            ).move_to(
                bob + 0.27 * np.array(
                    [np.sin(a), -np.cos(a), 0]
                )
            )

            label = Text(
                "Spyder Math",
                font_size=24,
                color=YELLOW,
            ).move_to([1.7, 2.7, 0])

            legs = VGroup()
            for side in (-1, 1):
                for i in range(3):
                    yoff = (i - 1) * 0.13
                    start = bob + np.array([side * 0.18, yoff, 0])
                    end = bob + np.array(
                        [
                            side * (0.55 + 0.08 * i),
                            yoff + (0.18 if i != 1 else 0),
                            0,
                        ]
                    )
                    legs.add(
                        Line(
                            start,
                            end,
                            color=PURPLE_A,
                            stroke_width=5,
                        )
                    )

            eye1 = Dot(
                head.get_center() + np.array([-0.07, 0.05, 0]),
                radius=0.035,
                color=WHITE,
            )

            eye2 = Dot(
                head.get_center() + np.array([0.07, 0.05, 0]),
                radius=0.035,
                color=WHITE,
            )

            return VGroup(
                rope,
                legs,
                body,
                head,
                eye1,
                eye2,
                label,
            )

        spider_mob = always_redraw(spider)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(orb_group),
            FadeIn(spider_mob),
            run_time=2,
        )
        self.wait(0.5)

        self.play(
            angle.animate.set_value(0.45),
            run_time=3,
            rate_func=there_and_back,
        )

        self.play(
            angle.animate.set_value(-0.45),
            run_time=3,
            rate_func=there_and_back,
        )

        self.wait(3.5)

from manim import *

class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#101522"

        arc = Arc(
            radius=3.0,
            start_angle=-0.25,
            angle=2.7,
            arc_center=LEFT * 0.2 + DOWN * 0.35,
            color=YELLOW,
            stroke_width=6,
        )
        arc_label = MathTex(
            r"\text{web swing arc}",
            font_size=28,
            color=YELLOW,
        ).next_to(arc, UP, buff=0.18)

        web = Line(
            LEFT * 0.2 + UP * 3.0,
            LEFT * 0.2 + UP * 2.15,
            color=WHITE,
            stroke_width=3,

        spider_body = Ellipse(
            width=0.72,

            spider_head.get_center() + LEFT * 0.11 + UP * 0.08

        eye_r = Circle(

            fill_color=WHITE,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(

        spyder = VGroup(

        orb = Circle(
            radius=0.78,
            color=BLUE,
            fill_color=BLUE_E,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(RIGHT * 2.0 + DOWN * 1.9)

        orb_core = Circle(
            radius=0.25,
            color=TEAL_A,
            fill_color=TEAL_A,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(orb.get_center())

        orb_eye_l = Circle(
            radius=0.09,
            color=WHITE,
            fill_color=WHITE,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(
            orb.get_center() + LEFT * 0.25 + UP * 0.18
        )

        orb_eye_r = Circle(
            radius=0.09,
            color=WHITE,
            fill_color=WHITE,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(
            orb.get_center() + RIGHT * 0.25 + UP * 0.18
        )

        orb_label = Text(
            "ProofMotion",
            font_size=30,
            color=WHITE,
        ).next_to(orb, DOWN, buff=0.25)

        orb_group = VGroup(
            orb,
            orb_core,
            orb_eye_l,
            orb_eye_r,
            orb_label,
        )

        attack = Arrow(
            orb.get_center() + UP * 0.65,
            orb.get_center() + UP * 1.8,
            color=ORANGE,
            stroke_width=7,
            buff=0.05,
        )

        attack_label = Text(
            "lunge!",
            font_size=28,
            color=ORANGE,
        ).move_to(
            orb.get_center() + RIGHT * 1.25 + UP * 0.15

        speed_lines = VGroup(
            Line(
                orb.get_center() + LEFT * 0.95 + UP * 0.35,
                orb.get_center() + LEFT * 1.55 + UP * 0.65,
                color=ORANGE,
                stroke_width=5,
            ),
            Line(
                orb.get_center() + RIGHT * 0.85 + UP * 0.1,
                orb.get_center() + RIGHT * 1.45 + UP * 0.25,
                color=ORANGE,

            Line(

        self.play(

            FadeIn(arc_label),
            Create(web),

        self.play(
            FadeIn(spyder),
            FadeIn(orb_group),
            run_time=1.5,

            FadeIn(speed_lines),
            GrowArrow(attack),

        self.play(
            orb_group.animate.shift(UP * 1.0),
            attack.animate.shift(UP * 1.0),
            attack_label.animate.shift(UP * 1.0),
            speed_lines.animate.shift(UP * 1.0),
            run_time=1.3,
        )

        self.play(
            MoveAlongPath(spyder, arc),
            run_time=3.5,
        )

        self.wait(1.2)
